name: goal-spec-plugin
description: Grouped-agent goal-spec orchestration skills for creating durable, verifier-gated, goal-executable specs.

interface.longDescription: Goal Spec turns ambiguous objectives into durable, verifier-gated execution contracts. It orchestrates grouped separate agents for framing, constraints, execution design, runtime policy, handoff, and review, while preserving internal specialist outputs for traceability.
defaultPrompt: Use $goal-spec to turn this objective into a goal-executable spec.
Use $goal-spec to create a durable goal contract for this project.
Use $goal-self-deepinterview to audit this goal spec draft.
